text:
24-hour news summary

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5075) Meta’s Muse Voice Transcribe offers real-time speech-to-text with native speaker diarization and endpointing.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5076) Anthropic introduced Claude Fable and Mythos 5.1, emphasizing coding, knowledge work, and research capabilities.

3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5077) Claude Fable 5.1 reportedly delivers stronger agentic benchmark performance, greater concision, and lower costs.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5078) Cybercabs are increasingly appearing on Austin’s streets.

5 World Labs’ Atlas generated unseen scene elements to turn phone footage into a time-freezing short film.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5080) Heart Aerospace flew the largest electric aircraft yet, featuring a 100-foot wingspan and weighing 25,000 pounds.

7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5081) Atlas can model spatial structure and time, transforming ordinary cameras into a bullet-time capture studio.

8 Fable 5.1 designed a house from a property-lot image, rendered it, and created a cinematic video through code.

9 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5083) Meta is reportedly switching from Google Chat to Slack, citing Slack’s strength as a platform for AI agents.

10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5084) Four IOI medalists published the first polynomial-time algorithm resolving a 50-year graph-theory problem.

11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5085) Fable 5.1 reportedly built a website for the channel owner at mehrzad.com.

12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5086) OpenAI’s GPT-Astra reportedly received release approval, with its cybercapability-enabled version restricted to Project Daybreak.

13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5087) OpenAI says Astra reaches the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under its Preparedness Framework.

14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5088) Google reportedly plans to release Gemini 3.8 Flash this week, with a strong focus on coding.

15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5089) Google reportedly abandoned Gemini 3.5 Pro candidates after insufficient gains over Flash, while Gemini 4 remains in post-training.

16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5090) Alibaba upgraded Qwen3.8-Max with 2.4 trillion parameters, a one-million-token context window, and additional coding and reasoning training.

17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5091) OpenAI and others are reportedly using loop transformers that improve performance while hiding more of their internal reasoning.

18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5092) Recurrent-depth transformers offer storage benefits for KV caches, but do not inherently reduce training or inference computation.

19 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5093) Astra’s recurrent-depth reasoning may improve cost and performance while making its thinking harder to monitor.

20 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5094) Astra reportedly uses a looped transformer that boosts performance but makes internal reasoning less readable.

--Hermes
